title: [Inactive] AFK Plugin - Discontinued
description: "AFKManagerX is a performance-friendly AFK detection plugin for Minecraft Paper 1.21.4, designed to efficiently track player activity and manage AFK statuses."
body:
### "This AFK plugin is no longer maintained and has been discontinued due to various issues. However, I am currently working on a new and improved plugin with more features and better performance. Stay tuned for updates! Thank you for your support!"

"AFKManagerX is a performance-friendly AFK detection plugin designed for Minecraft Paper 1.21.4 servers. It is recommended to run this plugin with JDK 23 or later to ensure compatibility and prevent any potential issues. Built with JDK 23, it efficiently tracks player activity and provides a customizable AFK management system. ⚙️🖥️🎮"

Key Features:
✅ Optimized AFK Detection – Checks players every 60 seconds and detects inactivity based on movement, command usage, and block interactions.
✅ Customizable AFK & Kick System – Players are marked as AFK after 5 minutes of inactivity and kicked after 10 minutes (fully configurable via config.yml).
✅ Flexible Messages & Settings – All AFK warnings, kick messages, and time settings can be adjusted through the configuration file.
✅ Admin Commands for Control

/afklist – Displays a list of currently AFK players.
/afkconfig reload – Reloads the configuration file without restarting the server.

✅ Lightweight Logging – Keeps log records minimal to avoid unnecessary data clutter.
With a clean and modular code structure, SimpleAFK ensures easy maintenance and future feature expansions. Perfect for server admins looking for a reliable and customizable AFK management solution!
